'''Vault 914''' was a vault built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was located in the [[ruined Rakata machine chamber]] in the [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], and was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to imprison the six [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] known as the [[Dread Masters]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], [[Special Operations Group One]] reached the vault and attempted to release the Dread Masters, but [[Esh-kha]] warriors interrupted them and wiped out the Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] before taking the Dread Masters' stasis chambers themselves.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vault 914 appears as an Imperial phase on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Imperial mission "Tracking the Dread Masters."<ref name="TOR" />
